description:
MoonSpot makes big ideas easier to understand. Explore artificial intelligence, science, space and emerging technology through concise explainers and longer deep dives.

We unpack the arguments, breakthroughs and unanswered questions shaping the future. Original sources and creators are credited in each video description.

Independent commentary and summaries. MoonSpot is not affiliated with the original creators or the Moonshots podcast.

Big ideas. Clearly explained.
